scope: F16 builder immediate invalidation repair only; Path Validator and generation fingerprint unchanged.
reproduction: A real temporary holder ancestor above the selected source root is renamed, replaced with an empty directory, observed through actual no-follow stat, then restored before the next check. After c.txt has been hashed, the transient ancestor inode mismatch is detected in the file's verify_active call. Old code records the error and clears c.txt only; previously hashed a.txt/b.txt stay observed. No fake stat objects or forged OS metadata are used.
repair: One invalidate_tree helper clears every emitted read_status/sha256 immediately. Both top-loop and post-file active-tree checks call it and end traversal on error. Independent file read errors retain the existing per-file handling.

runs.reason: The required all-prior-hashes-unresolved assertion fails; exact trace/log retained.

test_safety: Inspected existing tiny synthetic suite and new fixture. Each run supervised at30 seconds/1MiB logs. Sources under owned TemporaryDirectory only; no model/network/GUI/Keychain/personal roots. Existing CLI test is in-process. Temporary rename/rmdir applies only to this test's created empty replacement and is restored in finally.
limitations: No global filesystem snapshot or whole-tree resource bound.
No changes to separate Path Validator source authority or current-path checking yet.
No retrospective Reader generation invalidation guarantee.
Independent v1 auditor ran no dynamic tests due a reported scratch-file tool stall; this parent RED does not retroactively change that report.
No whole-product, actual model, packaging or old-index acceptance.
rollback: Reverse only immediate invalidate_tree helper/call changes and its added method if needed; preserve original F16 builder rewrite and other owners' changes.
